create_scaled_swiglu_layer: create a ScaledSwiGLU layer with specified in_channels and out_channels for gated activation
create_swiglu_layer: create a SwiGLU layer with specified in_channels and out_channels for gated linear unit activation
build_gate_activation: build a GateActivation module with lmax, mmax, and num_channels for equivariant tensor gating
create_separable_s2_activation: create a SeparableS2Activation module with lmax, mmax, and SO3_grid for S2 equivariant activation
create_smooth_leaky_relu: create a SmoothLeakyReLU activation with configurable negative_slope for smooth rectified linear units
